question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), then a tools/list on the same session, then two tools/call requests by hand, each with empty arguments and sent separately so the two answers can be compared: one naming get_realtime_supported_chains (today's name of the free tool) and one naming realtime_get_supported_chains (the name the 2026-09-20 record used); Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.challenge: none: the 200 carries no www-authenticate header
decoded.initialize: 200, SSE; serverInfo "MCP Server" 1.0.1 (3.4.7 on 2026-09-20); protocolVersion 2025-06-18; no mcp-session-id header was issued (one was on 2026-09-20), and the following calls were accepted without one; the instructions field still tells a client to fetch a sql-optimization skill before writing SQL (Part A section 1, Part B section 1)
decoded.tools-list: 200: 48 tools (46 on 2026-09-20; the script's transcript cuts the body at 20000 bytes, so the count is from the full body in Part B section 2, 148486 bytes); all 48 carry the tag auth_api_key in _meta.fastmcp.tags, 29 carry is_billed (28 on 2026-09-20), three name billing_currency:explorer_units (three)
decoded.tools-call: get_realtime_supported_chains (today's name of the tool the billing page lists as free; the 2026-09-20 record called it realtime_get_supported_chains, a name not in today's list) answers 200 with an isError result whose text begins "Not authenticated. Please sign in with your Allium account or configure an API key"; the old name answers the identical result, so the gate runs before the tool name is resolved (Part B sections 3 and 4)
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: not looked for on this host: no challenge and no resource document named one
decoded.sign-in-host: mcp-oauth.allium.so answers the same initialize with 401 and a challenge of scheme Bearer whose resource_metadata parameter names its own /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; that document answers 200: resource https://mcp-oauth.allium.so/, authorization_servers [https://mcp-oauth.allium.so/], scopes_supported [openid], bearer_methods_supported [header] (Part B sections 5 and 6)
decoded.rest: GET https://agents.allium.so/api/v1/supported-chains/realtime-apis/simple with no Authorization header answers 200 with the chain map, as on 2026-09-20 (Part B section 9); the priced endpoints' 402 is re-read in Part B sections 7 and 8 and belongs to the payment record

finding: With no credentials on 2026-09-28, an MCP initialize POST to mcp.allium.so answers 200 (serverInfo version 1.0.1, where the 2026-09-20 record read 3.4.7) and issues no session id; a tools/list without one answers 200 with 48 tools (46 on 2026-09-20), every one tagged auth_api_key by the server, 29 tagged is_billed; a call to the free tool under today's name get_realtime_supported_chains, and under the 2026-09-20 name realtime_get_supported_chains, answers the same Not authenticated error result inside a 200. The sign-in host mcp-oauth.allium.so refuses the same initialize with 401 and its resource document (200, read for the first time) names itself as authorization server with scopes_supported openid. The transport is open to a stranger and nothing behind it is; the accountless path is still the paid host measured in p-20260920-allium-machine-payments-unpaid, whose 402 shape was re-read the same minute and had not moved. One IP is one sample. No payment offer was observed on this host.
